stages.scene: A trainer's kid runs a berry stand and is short on change.
The kid is back, selling jam at a rest node.
A gust blows a trainer's hat into the grass.
The trainer appears again, hatless, at a rest node.
A wild Pokémon sneezes mid-battle and sprays pollen.

options.label: Wait it out
options.outcome: the wild Pokémon is distracted for a turn

stages.scene: The route ahead is a mud pit.

options.label: Cross carefully
options.outcome: lose a turn of steps, no harm

options.label: Push through
options.outcome: a Pokémon gets a mud-splattered cosmetic

options.label: Detour
options.outcome: a node later, find a berry

stages.scene: A fisherman complains the fish aren't biting.

options.label: Offer a berry
options.outcome: he gives you a rare bait

options.label: Ask for advice
options.outcome: a hint about the next water node

stages.scene: The fisherman waves from his boat and shows a big catch.
A trader offers to swap a held item for one of equal rarity.
A family invites you to share a picnic.

options.label: Join
options.outcome: party heals a little, morale up

stages.scene: A scarecrow in the field seems to move.

options.label: Inspect
options.outcome: it is a Pokémon in disguise, wild battle

stages.scene: Something glitters in the gravel.

options.label: Dig
options.outcome: a common stone or a coin

stages.scene: A wild Pokémon sits on the only ripe bush.

options.label: Share
options.outcome: 1 berry, the wild joins the walk for a node

stages.scene: A child asks for help finding a parent.

options.label: Escort
options.outcome: parent thanks you with a TM or item

stages.scene: The parent writes a thank-you note that arrives with a rare berry.

options.label: Pass it on to a Pokémon

stages.scene: A fountain glitters with coins.

options.label: Toss a coin
options.outcome: a mild luck flag for the next encounter

stages.scene: A kite tangles on a branch.

options.label: Free it
options.outcome: a flying-type wild gifts a feather

stages.scene: A vendor sells umbrellas on a clear day.

options.label: Buy one
options.outcome: an umbrella that protects one battle from rain chip

stages.scene: A market has one stall nobody visits.
A wild Pokémon sleeps in the middle of the path.

options.label: Leave a berry
options.outcome: it follows your team for a node

stages.scene: A bridge is half-fallen.
A kid shows off a homemade gadget.
The kid returns with a better gadget.
A kid wants to swap trading cards.
A sudden shower; a small shelter has room for one.

options.label: Share the shelter with your team

stages.scene: A bird sings a tune you almost know.
A vending machine stands alone in the wild.
An old trail marker is faded.

options.label: Repaint it
options.outcome: a hint about the next biome

stages.scene: A small festival fills the square.
A Poké Ball rolls across the path.
A puddle shows a strangely clear image.

options.label: Look closer
options.outcome: a hint at the next encounter

stages.scene: A merchant naps by his wares.

options.label: Take a small item and leave a coin
Take it and run
options.outcome: a free item, and a flag

stages.scene: Two kids are battling and want a referee.

options.label: Referee
options.outcome: a friendly tip and a coin

stages.scene: An old gatherer offers herbs for a small favor.
She sets a small herb garden at a rest node.
Large footprints cross the path.

options.label: Follow them
options.outcome: a wild battle with an uncommon local

stages.scene: Campers sing around a fire.

options.label: Join in
options.outcome: friendship up for a Pokémon that likes music

stages.scene: A sign points to two paths.
A wild water Pokémon is caught in a net.
Kids invite you to play hopscotch.

options.label: Play
options.outcome: a Pokémon enjoys itself, morale up

stages.scene: A wild Pokémon steals a berry from your pack.

options.label: Chase it
options.outcome: a short wild battle to retrieve it

stages.scene: A small puzzle box lies on a rock.
A calm pool in a dry stretch.
A bard sings about an earlier node in your run.

options.label: Listen
options.outcome: a small friendship bump to your lead

options.label: Tip
options.outcome: a clue about the next rare event

stages.scene: A photographer asks to take your team's portrait.

options.label: Pose
options.outcome: a team photo is saved to the run log

stages.scene: A strong gust scatters items.
A vendor sells eggs with hairline cracks.
A wild Pokémon hides and peeks.
A nest of wild Pokémon rustles in the grass.
A vendor sells raincoats for Pokémon.
A loud trainer practices drum rolls.

options.label: Listen
options.outcome: friendship up for a rhythm-loving Pokémon

stages.scene: A well has gone dry.
A child offers a flower crown.

options.label: Accept
options.outcome: a Pokémon wears it, morale up

stages.scene: A ring of mushrooms glows faintly.
A crate sits half-buried.

options.label: Open
options.outcome: a TM or a common item

stages.scene: A signpost refuses to turn from its direction.

options.label: Turn it
options.outcome: a hint at the next rest node

stages.scene: A backpack lies by the trail with a half-written letter inside.
The owner appears, searching for it.

options.label: Return it if you left it

stages.scene: A hooded merchant opens a small case.

options.label: Ask about an item
options.outcome: a story that gives a hint

stages.scene: The merchant waits at a later node, offering a discount.
A wild Pokémon guards a glowing item.

options.label: Battle it
options.outcome: the item and a catchable wild

options.label: Offer a berry
options.outcome: the guard lets you pass, smaller reward

stages.scene: A Ground-type or curious teammate starts digging.
The dug hole is now a small den.
A researcher asks you to photograph a specific type.

options.label: Accept
options.outcome: a quest to meet a type this run

stages.scene: Back with the photograph.
A note from your rival is tucked under a rock.

options.label: Read it
options.outcome: a hint about their next team

options.label: Burn it
options.outcome: nothing, your rival is pleased later

stages.scene: A trainer carrying the note's sign challenges you.
Half a treasure map in a bottle.

options.label: Keep it
options.outcome: a quest to find the other half

stages.scene: You find the other half.
A trainer with no Pokémon of their own asks to join a battle.

options.label: Lend a Pokémon for one battle
options.outcome: they win a coin and give you one

stages.scene: The trainer returns with a Pokémon of their own.
A tree seems to whisper.
The tree sheds a rare seed.

options.label: Plant it
options.outcome: a berry plant at a rest node

stages.scene: A pond glows at night.
A tailor offers to stitch a trinket for a Pokémon.

options.label: Accept
options.outcome: a cosmetic charm that slightly boosts friendship

stages.scene: The tailor returns with a new design.
A ferryman asks for a story as payment.

options.label: Tell a story from your run

stages.scene: A small shrine wants an offering.

options.label: Pray
options.outcome: a vision of the next boss's type

stages.scene: A shrine keeper thanks you.
A machine hums but doesn't work.
A market only open at night.
An echo answers questions in the cave.

options.label: Ask what is ahead
options.outcome: a hint about the next node

stages.scene: A ranger asks for help with a wild Pokémon in trouble.

options.label: Help
options.outcome: a rare berry and an ally NPC

stages.scene: The ranger returns with a reward.
A Pokémon looks around for its trainer.

options.label: Look for the trainer
options.outcome: the trainer appears at the next rest node

stages.scene: The trainer thanks you.
A chef invites you to a quick cook-off.
A snowstorm closes the pass.

options.label: Push on
options.outcome: take chip damage but save a node

stages.scene: A guest shares a map.

options.label: Accept
options.outcome: a hint for the next biome

stages.scene: An egg rolls down a hill.
The egg's parent searches.
A glyph puzzle blocks the way.
Stones hum a faint tune.
Villagers dance to bring rain.

options.label: Join
options.outcome: a rain flag for your next battle

stages.scene: Rain falls at your next battle.
A local contest rewards the best bug.
Kids built a tree house and offer you a rest.
The kids challenge you.
A wreck washes ashore.
A diver asks about the wreck.
A caravan camp offers water.
A voice sings from a rooftop.

options.label: Listen
options.outcome: friendship up for a Ghost or Psychic type

stages.scene: The singer reveals themselves.
A flower blooms inside ice.
A gift box with your rival's initials.
Your rival mentions it.
A long queue outside a famous bakery.
The baker remembers you.
A keeper lets you pick one fruit.
A bard sings of a distant battle.

options.label: Listen
options.outcome: a hint about the next boss

stages.scene: A scarecrow shouts a challenge.
The scarecrow offers a reward.
A courier races across rooftops.

options.label: Race
options.outcome: a speed item if you win

stages.scene: The lighthouse keeper naps.
The keeper wakes up.
A collector wants a specific Pokémon type for a photo.
The collector returns with a counter-offer.
Low tide exposes pools.
A hill keeps getting struck by lightning.
You find an egg beside an empty nest.
A worried Breeder asks if anyone has seen an egg.

options.label: Return it
options.outcome: the Breeder becomes a recurring NPC with a rare-egg offer

options.label: Admit it and offer a trade
options.outcome: the Breeder offers a fair swap

stages.scene: The egg hatches or the Breeder reappears.

options.label: Accept the result
options.outcome: an unusual Pokémon, or a Mystery Egg from the Breeder

options.label: Pass it on to someone who needs it more
options.outcome: a thank-you note and a small friendship bump

stages.scene: A trainer challenges you with a team of three.

options.label: Decline
options.outcome: the trainer shrugs and walks on

stages.scene: They return. If you won, their team has evolved and added a counter to your most-used type; if you lost, they are cocky with +2 levels.
Final rematch with a full team.

options.label: Battle
options.outcome: their ace's held item or a TM

stages.scene: A researcher studies a Pokémon behaving oddly.

options.label: Help
options.outcome: collect data in a wild battle

stages.scene: The experiment succeeded or misfired (50/50, seeded).
Track the unstable Pokémon.

options.label: Defeat it
options.outcome: the researcher's gratitude and a Mystery Egg

stages.scene: A duelist waits at a crossroads and demands a single battle.
The duelist asks for a rematch with a rival's help.
They offer a farewell gift.
A trainer cries that a badge was stolen.
You find the thief.
The badge is returned.
A postman gives you a letter meant for someone else.
The recipient is found.
A reply is written.
A cook offers a secret recipe if you gather three berries.
The berries are delivered.
The dish is served.

options.label: Eat
options.outcome: a team-wide buff for one battle

stages.scene: A lighthouse flickers on with no keeper.
A ghostly keeper appears.
The light is restored.
A camp is found abandoned, notes scattered.
Survivors are found.
The survivors reach a town.
A small gym with a flamboyant leader has a rule: only use one type.
The leader gives you a second challenge.
The leader awards a badge of their own.

options.label: Wear it
options.outcome: a cosmetic and a small buff

stages.scene: A circus sets up overnight and invites you in.
The ringmaster asks you to join an act.
The finale.
A trainer with a team identical to yours in type stands waiting.
They return stronger.
Final mirror.
A star falls near the route at dusk.
A strange stone sits in the crater.
The stone hums.
A whale song echoes across the bay.
The whale surfaces.

options.label: Ride
options.outcome: a short trip to a new route

stages.scene: A gift floats up.
A rock formation looks like a giant asleep.
The giant speaks (a Rock-type wild).
The giant offers a gem.
A shrine keeper has lost the key to the shrine.
The key is found.
The shrine's offering.
Trees chime like glass.
A glass Pokémon appears.
Shards remain.
A casual traveler challenges you to a friendly battle.
The traveler reappears, hinting at a bigger identity.
The traveler reveals themselves.
A comet streaks the sky and a stranger asks what you'd wish for.
The wish settles.
The stranger returns.
A cave only opens at low tide.
Inside, an ancient chamber.
The tide returns.

options.label: Race out
options.outcome: a minor damage and a rare item

stages.scene: A nurse running a late clinic asks for help.
A rival trainer arrives with a hurt Pokémon.
The clinic thanks you.
A hidden garden lives on a rooftop.
The garden flourishes.
A caretaker appears.
A village asks for your help to end a drought.

options.label: Agree
options.outcome: a quest to find a rain Pokémon

stages.scene: The Pokémon is found.

options.label: Battle
options.outcome: a wild with a rain boost

stages.scene: The rain falls.
An apprentice pleads for help climbing a tower.
The trial.
The apprentice reaches the top.
A clockwork toy cat wanders the street.

options.label: Follow
options.outcome: it leads to a hidden shop

stages.scene: The shop owner explains.
The cat returns, working.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: the cat follows you for a node

stages.scene: A bell rings under the water.
The bell is found.
The bell rings again.
Tiny tracks lead through snow.
The fox shows itself.
The fox returns with a gift.
Three runners invite you to join their marathon.
Mid-race.
The finish.
Two gyms argue over a badge.
The feud escalates.
The gyms reconcile.
An old keeper claims his vane predicts your next battle.
His forecast came true.
The vane spins wildly.
A dojo hidden behind a waterfall.
The master tests you.
The master teaches a technique.
A merchant who never speaks offers a single item.
He nods at a later node.
He leaves a note.

options.label: Read it
options.outcome: a map to a hidden market

stages.scene: A trail shows scenes from your run so far.

options.label: Walk it
options.outcome: see highlights from the run log

stages.scene: A scene stops on a regret.

options.label: Accept
options.outcome: a mood boost and a lesson

stages.scene: The trail ends.

options.label: Take a keepsake
options.outcome: a charm tied to the run

stages.scene: A rift in space holds a perfectly set picnic.

options.label: Eat
options.outcome: a heal and a strange feeling

stages.scene: The picnicker returns.
The picnic fades.
A whale-shaped island rises.
The villagers ask for a game.
The island sinks.
A trainer in silver armor challenges only the strongest Pokémon on your team.
The armor cracks open.
The trainer yields.
A bridge only visible at dusk.
A voice offers a vision.

options.label: Accept
options.outcome: a vision of the next boss

stages.scene: The bridge fades.
A lake shows your team as a different team.
The alt-team challenges you.
The lake ripples.
A compass points at a star.
The star shifts.
The compass leads to a hidden camp.
A ghost of a past champion appears in the road.
It challenges you.
It disappears.
A mushroom throne in a clearing.
The queen asks a favor.
The queen thanks you.
A night of lanterns on the water.
Your lantern drifts back.
The lanterns dim.
A library carved in ice holds frozen books.
The librarian appears.
The library thaws.
A city made of folded paper.
The mayor asks for help.
The city thanks you.
A pilgrim carries a flame across the world.
The flame flickers.
The flame is delivered.
A train arrives at an empty platform.
A passenger speaks.
The train stops.
Translucent trainers watch you across a field.
They challenge you.
They fade.
A gate stands open in the ruins with no wall around it.
A voice asks your name.
A path appears.
A market that only appears under a full moon.
A merchant asks a riddle.
The market fades.
A shadow passes overhead.
It drops a feather.
The shadow returns.

options.label: Wave
options.outcome: a ride to a new node

entries.title: The Last Trainer of the Town

stages.scene: A town is empty except for one trainer who insists on a battle.

options.label: Decline
options.outcome: the trainer nods and walks into the sunset

stages.scene: You find a photo of the old town.
The trainer leaves the town behind.
A mirror shows your team's best moments from this run.
The mirror asks which moment you'd change.
The mirror closes.
A lighthouse recites every ship that has passed.
A ghost ship appears.
The light dims.
Every Pokémon in the area is asleep, even your own.
A dream-eater is nearby.
Everyone wakes.
A trainer claims they have never lost a battle.
They return, having lost.
They become a mentor.
Ghostly musicians play in an old hall.
The conductor nods.
The finale.
A museum lets you in after hours.
A guard asks what you're doing.
A secret exhibit.
A lone Ferris wheel turns.
At the top you see something.

options.label: Look
options.outcome: a hint at the next boss

stages.scene: At the bottom.
A mailbox holds a letter addressed to you.

options.label: Read it
options.outcome: advice that turns out to be accurate

stages.scene: The advice comes true.
A second letter.
Tiny Pokémon fight over a single flower.
The winner offers you the flower.
They invite you to referee.
A trainer refuses to give a name.
Their team returns changed.
They finally tell you.

stages.scene: An old Pokémon asks for a berry and refuses everything else.
The Pokémon returns with something.
The seed grows.

options.label: Plant it
options.outcome: a rare tree at a rest node

stages.scene: A trainer asks to borrow a badge for one battle.

options.label: Lend
options.outcome: they win a battle and return it

stages.scene: They return with a thank-you.
The coin hums.
A snow globe contains a tiny version of this very scene.
A tiny figure waves.
The globe cracks.
Pokémon dance at the edge of a cliff at dawn.
The leader steps to you.
The sun rises.
An egg that has been unhatched for a century.
It starts to glow.
It hatches.
A well sings back your voice.
The well answers with a question.
The well is quiet.
A banner for a tournament that never happened hangs in a square.
You are invited to hold it.
A trophy.
A Pokémon watches your team from a distance.
It keeps following.
It leaves.

One of them is a rival.
Morning.
A whirlpool swallows a small boat, leaving a feather behind.
A sunken shrine hums.
A vast shadow rises.

options.label: Retreat
options.outcome: Lugia leaves and a flag remains

stages.scene: A rainbow feather falls from a clear sky.
Burnt footprints cross the route.
A burning shape in the sky.

options.label: Bow
options.outcome: the Pokémon departs and a flag remains

stages.scene: Three crests appear on a distant cliff.

options.label: Climb
options.outcome: a trial of ice, thunder and flame

stages.scene: The first trial: survive 6 turns against a storm.
The final trial.

options.label: Battle
options.outcome: one of the three birds, capture allowed

A voice speaks directly into your mind.
A gleaming shape.

options.label: Walk away
options.outcome: Mewtwo vanishes and a flag remains

stages.scene: A rumor of three beasts running together.

options.label: Track them

stages.scene: A glimpse across a field.
They stop at a lake.
A weather crisis shakes the coast.
Rain and drought clash.
The sky answers.

options.label: Retreat
options.outcome: the sky calms and a flag remains

stages.scene: A shimmer crosses the sky.
A flying shape that leads you.
The siblings speak with their minds.

options.label: Listen
options.outcome: a bond flag and no battle

A second door.
Inside, a statue wakes.

options.label: Battle
options.outcome: one of the Regis, capture allowed

stages.scene: Two giant crests glow in a sky.
A trial of time and space.
The sky tears open.

A shadow stalks you.

A fierce light.
